items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: And then my mother used to work for the Renaissance family... And I was raised there with them... And when my mother stopped working there, then she put me with me Jarot. For French.

ctx.x: Oh, you had French teachers? Yes. Did you have sisters?
No, no, it was Miss Jarot, she's dead now. Miss Amanda Jarot.

items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: Well, I had French teachers. ... it was Miss Jarot, she's dead now. Miss Amanda Jarot.

ctx.x: They had a hall… I can't remember the name. D'Anterial Church… Preston, Villery, Robinson and between Columbus, between St. Andes. No hallway, no dog people was allowed. From Zambia? From Zambia. Did you go to some sort of French school when you were a child?
Oh, you had French teachers? Yes. Did you have sisters?
